title: Przyzwanie 02 Dach Przed Rytualem
description: ustanawia geografię: dach wysokiego sąsiedniego bloku, Dom Kultury znajduje się tuż poniżej poza kadrem.

prompts.image: Photorealistic exact Polish apartment-block rooftop before the summoning succeeds. Preserve wet roofing felt, concrete utility hut, antennas, practical lamp, banner, graffiti and urban blocks. The exact ritual-costumed Mistrz Konca stands alone beside a crude waist-high metal ritual stand with both arms lowered, preparing. Empty storm sky and moon, absolutely no organic ships. Locked wide cold-blue night frame with warm rooftop lamp. No new person, creature, portal, text or watermark.
prompts.animation:
One continuous 3-second static establishing shot. Wind pulls
slightly at the banner and coat; the ritualist raises one hand toward the empty
sky. No creatures appear yet.
